name: Start-up Entrepreneur Programme (STEP)

value.note: for the first founder; +€30,000 per additional founder

requirements.blocker_text: This requires minimum funding of €50,000 for the first founder (+€30,000 per additional founder), for a High Potential Start-Up: an innovative product/service in manufacturing or internationally traded services, capable of creating 10 jobs and €1m in sales within 3-4 years, HQ'd and controlled in Ireland.
requirements.fix_path: Secure the required funding and develop a qualifying business plan.

evidence_required.document: Business plan meeting High Potential Start-Up criteria
Funding evidence meeting the required threshold

sources.title: Start-up Entrepreneur Programme - Immigration Service Delivery

notes: STALE-DATA FLAG confirmed: at least one tier-3 site (Stamped Nomad) states the main funding figure as €75,000 — this is WRONG; the official ISD/Citizens Information figure is €50,000 for the first founder. Assessed by an independent Evaluation Committee on innovation, job-creation potential, and viability — explicitly NOT for retail/catering/local services, a real scope restriction worth flagging. Grants Stamp 4 directly, a genuine advantage over most other business/entrepreneur routes in this dataset which typically require an intermediate step before reaching settlement-equivalent status.
